fixture_only_baseline_request_recommenda.fair_native_baseline: Allow a native caller the same two batched reads, same cached first capture, same explicit objects, same topology/precision and same already available relation facts. Geometry/relations absent from native data are an explicit acquisition/compute requirement, never free work.
fixture_only_baseline_request_recommenda.primary_relation_source_scope: Use the single same-source P1 capture with existing localized crossing evidence. Older responses lacking that field are catalogued separately, not silently upgraded.
fixture_only_baseline_request_recommenda.sampling_scope: Identifiers and task thresholds occur only in this fixture recommendation. Generic code accepts selectors and fields.
fixture_only_baseline_request_recommenda.simplification_candidate: Check for repeated bounds/center values and unnecessary geometry fields within the frozen two-object request. Keep any before/after field change identical on both comparison paths.

stage1.optional_center: derive from identical bounds on both paths
stage1.selection: all 28 meshes in the same capture

stage2.precision: same capture/world metres/finite binary64 round-trip, same current-capture index ordering
stage2.reference_full_meshes: Not requested by default. Stage-1 bounds support their task-position use.
stage2.relation_fields: Exactly the same already recorded relation payload and source binding on both offline projections.

fixture_only_baseline_request_recommenda.status: Recommendation to freeze before measurement, not a product rule.

supplement_union_request.scope: Optional full union of all six coordinate reads, with explicit topology added for generic shape inspection. Exclude this optional larger request from the primary default comparison.

frozen_scoring_required.complete_correct: Correct target and all three public-position explanations, correct identities for all three roles, all three supported relation classes and pair-local sufficient evidence, with no material contradiction. Individual stage counts are still reported; correct guesses without evidence and unknown do not pass the full task. Valid analytic shortcuts and equivalent evidence are accepted without prescribing a tool or algorithm.
frozen_scoring_required.initial_image_limit: INITIAL.png may support layout/appearance and candidate localization. It cannot alone prove a hidden common interior, distinguish the approximately0.100007mm gap or establish exact touching. No new or local image is required or permitted in this phase.
frozen_scoring_required.no_forced_route: No compulsory plugin/nearest call, call count, universal full mesh recomputation, view change or trust instruction. Necessary supplements and redundant full re-solves are attributed separately after quality judgment.

roles.acceptable_local_evidence: Pair-bound strict interior witness with its geometric meaning, independently checkable material-region intersection, or a source-bound exact solid-interior certificate accompanied by a local location/feature identifying the shared material region.
roles.independent_basis: strict common-interior point on the actual original closed meshes; positive exact material intersection volume
insufficient_alone: an unlocated assertion that a tool says overlap
roles.natural_role: 目标近右侧竖直窄隔片

roles.acceptable_local_evidence: Exclusion of interior overlap plus an attained surface gap or sufficiently tight geometric bounds lying entirely at or below the class tolerance, with pair-local points/features or corresponding measurement.
roles.independent_basis: exact absence of common interior; attained shortest surface distance is below 0.00025m
insufficient_alone: exact physical touching inferred from tolerance
small unsigned distance with no solid-overlap exclusion

roles.acceptable_local_evidence: Source-bound opening/material containment or disjointness argument and sufficiently tight gap/witness evidence above tolerance. The visible opening alone does not establish all hidden geometry.
roles.independent_basis: rod occupies the opening void, not frame material; exact zero material intersection and an attained positive surface gap above tolerance
insufficient_alone: a visible hole with no account of the rod's actual extent
surface separation value used to infer absence of containment without a solid/material argument
roles.natural_role: 穿过目标开口的直探杆

target.accepted_reasoning: Equivalent geometric descriptions, valid bounds or numerical checks that establish all three conditions; no prescribed calculation algorithm or exhaustive face enumeration.
target.center_definition: world-axis-aligned bounds of actual vertices, not origin, mass centroid or apparent screen center
three_conditions: center Z strictly below lower/upper hollow-rail center-Z midpoint
center Y strictly beyond the front solid crossbeam rear/max-Y surface
center XY within closed radius 0.70m of the dual-pipe-axis XY midpoint

generic_field_requirements.directory_center: An optional explicit field derived from the same bounds; omit it on both paths if the simplified request derives it.
generic_field_requirements.precision: For the prospective comparison, both paths use the same finite binary64 capture coordinates and round-trip JSON encoding, or one identically declared quantization policy.
selected_optional_geometry: triangles OR polygons with an explicit topology encoding and capture-local vertex indices
generic_field_requirements.source_binding: Same immutable capture, document/object instance binding and source revision. Separate captures need explicit identity/currentness checks.
